def fetch_all_text(sender_phone, page_limit=20):
    all_msgs=[]
    page_index=0
    while True:
        res = apis.phone.search_text_messages(access_token=phone_token, phone_number=sender_phone, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        print('text page', page_index, 'items', len(res) if isinstance(res,list) else res)
        if not res:
            break
        all_msgs.extend(res)
        page_index += 1
        if page_index>50:
            break
    return all_msgs
